_meta.source: California Department of Public Health / HCAI — Asthma Emergency Department Visit Rates by ZIP Code, All Ages, 2013-2023 (rates per 10,000 residents, age-adjusted).
_meta.geography: West Oakland: mean of ZIP codes 94607 and 94608 (visit counts kept for reference).
_meta.note: Diagnostic coding changed from ICD-9 (493) to ICD-10 (J45) on 2015-10-01; CDPH advises against directly comparing rates across that boundary. The 2020 drop reflects pandemic-era ED avoidance. 2021-2022 were not published for these ZIPs at release time.
